questions.question: How many days of per-day history should the stats endpoint return?
questions.why: The duration is an explicit open point and determines the product-visible data window and response.

questions.question: Are stats public like metadata, or must a requester provide the management token?
questions.why: This is an access-control decision affecting who can see link performance data; choosing incorrectly could expose sensitive business information.

questions.question: When a link is deleted, should its stored click data be erased or retained internally?
questions.why: FR3 requires deleted links to have no stats available but does not specify data erasure. Retention and deletion are privacy and data-lifecycle decisions.
